final_note: You worked through titration calculations and gas volumes.

concepts.def: 24 dm^3 at room temp and pressure

walkthroughs.body_html:
Use a pipette for the acid/alkali in the flask.

Add indicator; titrate from burette.

Take mean of concordant results only.

n(acid) = c x V (in dm^3).

From balanced equation, find n(alkali).

c(alkali) = n / V.

1 mole of any gas = 24 dm^3 at RTP.

So 0.5 mol = 12 dm^3.
